room_rent.note: Single occupancy AC room allowed for all SI options under Enrich Healthline

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to SI; no separate sub-limit stated

copayment.note: No age-based co-pay. 20% co-pay applies if treatment in Tier 1 hospital but premium paid for Tier 2 location.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise sub-limits stated for this plan

maternity.note: Maternity is excluded under Enrich Healthline plan

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% of SI per claim-free year, maximum 100% of SI; reduced by 50% of SI on a claim year

restoration.note: Double Sum Insured available for Critical Illness/Accident claims only (not a general restoration)

modern_treatments.note: Day care procedures list includes modern procedures; no explicit modern treatment sub-limit stated

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumables excluded per Annexure 2; Home Care Treatment add-on covers some consumables optionally

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only

notable_exclusions: STDs, self-injury, war, nuclear, circumcision, vaccination (non-bite), durable medical equipment, external congenital anomalies, refractive error <7.5D
optional_riders: Medical Second Opinion, Flexi OP Care (OPD), Home Care Treatment; Child Hospitalisation Allowance ₹500/day (7 days) inbuilt
insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
